scientific_integrity: All-parameter results justified by analytical sign-variation, Kummer-identity and heat-equation proof; 170 finite deterministic checks are diagnostics, not exhaustive evidence.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional, symmetric, harmonic trapped run-and-tumble diffusion with additive thermal Gaussian noise; fixed persistence 0<ell<1 for modal square-root law. Previously published implicit curvature criterion and transition profile are credited; no independent validation or publication-priority certification. General modality theorems could cover some refinements.
title: Rigorous uniqueness and universal mode splitting at the trapped run-and-tumble thermal transition
